title: ChatEvent
description: The `data:` of one server-sent event of the answer stream of POST /chat (agent-openapi.yaml). The SSE `event:` name always equals `type`. A stream is (text | tool_call)* followed by: on success, an optional notice `correction` and `end`; when the model fails, an optional notice `mid_stream`, one `fallback` and `end`; when the server cannot go on, `error`. Exactly one `end` or `error` closes every stream and nothing follows it.

text.title: ChatTextEvent
text.description: A piece of the answer, to append to the text shown so far (streamed as the model writes it).

tool_call.title: ChatToolCallEvent
tool_call.description: The model called one of the read-only MCP tools (for display, e.g. a 'reading your status' line). The arguments are the model's, as it sent them.

fallback.title: ChatFallbackEvent
fallback.description: The model failed or could not be reached: a deterministic summary of the current status built without the LLM (English plain text, several lines). It replaces any text streamed before it.

notice.title: ChatNoticeEvent
notice.description: A warning about the answer. `mid_stream`: the model failed after streaming some text, which must be discarded (a `fallback` follows). `correction`: the answer streamed contained wording that sounds like a diagnosis; keep the text and show the notice next to it (`end` follows). `text` is an English rendering; the UI may write its own words from `code`.

end.title: ChatEndEvent
end.description: The answer is complete. The turn joined the conversation history unless a `fallback` was sent.

error.title: ChatErrorEvent
error.description: The stream ends without a complete answer; the turn is not in the history. `unavailable`: the agent cannot reach what it needs (the MCP tool server) or is shutting down; retrying later may work. `invalid`: the conversation was forgotten (DELETE) while answering. `internal`: a bug in the agent. `busy` is not sent by this version once the stream is open (a busy conversation is refused with 409 before it); it is in the enum so that a client treats it like that 409. `message` is English, for logs.
